verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs (evidence pack) make no mention of GPU vendor driver installation or kernel module/DKMS/akmods support, so there's no vendor claim to fully validate the story. Community comments only obliquely touch on GPU drivers, noting Nvidia support works partially (e.g., suspend fixed) but also citing it as the 'biggest complaint' and lacking CUDA/10-bit support for professional workloads.
